text:
anya: quick sync — PM ask: we need gating for the SDK surface changes tied to the new structured-output schema + function-calling tweaks. want to lock launch criteria by EOW.

matt: +1. can we list the breaking bits up front? my worry is typed clients will error if we change field names.

anya: good point. breaks are: renamed `response.items` -> `response.rows`, added top-level `meta` object, and function-calling now allows `tool_results` array. also changing streaming tokens shape a bit.

raj: for the TS client the main risk is the exported types. we can keep old type aliases for one minor release and mark deprecated. but runtime shape must still accept both `items` and `rows` for a migration window.

ben: for Python client we prefer a single canonical attr (.rows) and provide a shim property `items` that maps to .rows. avoids hampering dataclasses.

anya: sounds reasonable. propose gating checklist: 1) backward-compat shims in both clients; 2) docs examples for both old/new shapes; 3) migration guide + changelog entry; 4) e2e test w/ hosted and dedicated routing; 5) canary rollout plan in Redwood Console.

sara: add: 6) evals to check structured output regressions for our standard prompts (rerank/QA templates). we should fail gating if model output breaks the schema >2% on smoke set.

matt: question on function-calling: do we change the function invocation envelope? if yes, we need to update the SDK helper that turns tool responses into typed objects.

anya: we want to extend envelope to support multiple tool invocations per response (tool_results array). SDK change: parser should return list[ToolInvocation] and keep previous single-invocation API as convenience.

raj: OK. I'll draft the TS API that exposes `invoke_tools()` returning an async iterable of invocations for streaming, and `tool_results` list on final response. will keep `tool_call` legacy prop and mark deprecated.

ben: I'll do the Python side: add `response.tool_results` (list of ToolResult), keep `response.tool_call` property mapping to first element, and update docs. we should include a short migration snippet in both changelogs.

anya: about changelog wording: docs-bot, can you remind us of the preferred format? we need one-line summary, migration steps, severity, and revert plan.

here's a suggested changelog entry snippet:```
- NLP: Structured output schema updated (response.items -> response.rows).
  - Migration: SDKs provide backward-compatible shims for two releases. See migration guide.
  - Severity: Minor-breaking; requires client update for typed strict mode.
```

docs-bot: changelog template: one-line summary, impact level {none, minor, major}, migration steps, example code, release note tag. url: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelogs

matt: logistics for rollout — eng-runtime: can we support dual-shape acceptance at serving layer? we should accept both shapes to avoid partial failures.

ben: runtime can accept both; we will canonicalize to rows before SDK serialization. need to add small conversion cost but negligible.

anya: final gating timeline: draft PRs for clients + runtime by Thu COB, docs + migration guide by Fri, internal canary next Tue, public rollout the following Mon if canary healthy.

raj: I'll open the TS PR now and tag @matt for runtime changes.

ben: Python PR incoming, will include tests + examples.

matt: I'll add a canary plan in the release-war-room channel and set a 48h monitor with latency/cost/format-regressions.

anya: thanks. last ask: please add a short example for structured output in both languages. minimal example for docs:```
# Python example
resp = client.chat.create(prompt, schema="structured")
print(resp.rows[0].content)
# backwards compat
print(resp.items[0].content)

// TypeScript example
const resp = await client.chat.create({prompt, schema: 'structured'});
console.log(resp.rows[0].content);
// legacy alias
console.log(resp.items?.[0].content);
```

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: dev-cluster -> next Tue 03:00 UTC. auto-rollback on >2% schema regression.

anya: perfect. tagging this as `action: draft PRs` — everyone assigned: raj/ben/matt/sara. I'll post the launch gating doc in Confluence and link back here when done. :thumbsup:

sara: ack, I'll start the evals and post results in this thread.

matt: ack

raj: ack

ben: ack

anya: closing the loop — will update thread when docs link is live.
